units.title: tasks.v1 contract: TasksService rpcs, messages and event payloads
units.notes: Package tasks.v1, no go_package. Task (title, notes, priority LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/URGENT, deadline as date + optional local time, status OPEN/DONE, assignee user ids), Birthday (name, day, month, optional year, remind_days_before). RPCs: List/Create/Update/Complete/Reopen/DeleteTask, List/Create/Update/DeleteBirthday, Get/SetFamilySettings (IANA timezone, default from device), ConnectGoogle (auth code + PKCE verifier + redirect uri), DisconnectGoogle, ListGoogleCalendars, SetGoogleCalendar, GetGoogleConnection, ListMyDueReminders / AckReminder / SnoozeReminder (1h | tomorrow 09:00) / GetDigest for the telegram scheduler. Event messages TaskAssignedEvent, TaskDueEvent, BirthdayUpcomingEvent. Brief defaults adopted for every open question.

units.title: Google connect / disconnect / list + pick calendar RPCs; FailedPrecondition when OAuth unset

units.title: Calendar push sync: task/birthday -> Google event create/update/delete
units.notes: Completed task keeps its event with a check-mark title prefix (brief default). Birthdays as yearly all-day events. Tests use gcal fake.

units.title: Hook calendar push into task and birthday handlers
units.notes: Create/edit/complete/delete task with deadline and create/edit/delete birthday drive the fake Google calendar; failures logged and retried by the pull loop, never fail the write.

units.title: Calendar pull sync: incremental syncToken polling applies Google edits/deletes
units.notes: No watch channels (non-goal). Event edited in Google updates title/deadline; deleted event deletes task/birthday.
